questions.explanation: J. J. Thomson discovered the electron. Chadwick discovered the neutron; Rutherford and Bohr proposed atomic models.
James Chadwick discovered the neutron, a neutral particle in the nucleus with mass nearly equal to a proton.

questions.q: In Thomson's model, the atom is described as…
options: A tiny dense nucleus with electrons far away
A sphere of positive charge with electrons embedded in it
Protons and neutrons with no electrons
questions.explanation: Thomson pictured a positive sphere with electrons embedded, like seeds in a watermelon.

questions.q: In the gold-foil experiment, most alpha particles passed straight through because…
options: The foil had holes in it
Most of the atom is empty space
The nucleus fills the whole atom
questions.explanation: Only a few particles deflected, showing the atom is mostly empty with a small dense nucleus.

questions.q: How many electrons can the M shell (n = 3) hold at most?
questions.explanation: Maximum per shell is 2n²; for n = 3 that is 2 × 3² = 18.

questions.q: No matter what 2n² allows, the OUTERMOST shell of an atom can hold at most how many electrons?
questions.explanation: A Bohr–Bury rule: the outermost shell holds at most 8 electrons, and inner shells fill before outer ones.

questions.q: The electrons in the outermost shell of an atom are called…
questions.explanation: Outermost-shell electrons are valence electrons; they decide an atom's valency (combining capacity).

questions.q: A noble gas has a completely filled outermost shell. Its valency is…
questions.explanation: A full outer shell is stable, so the atom neither gains nor loses electrons — valency is zero.

questions.q: An atom has atomic number 11 and mass number 23. How many neutrons does it have?
Carbon-12 and carbon-14 are examples of…
questions.explanation: Same element (same atomic number), different mass numbers → isotopes. They have the same chemical properties.

questions.q: Calcium-40 and argon-40 have the same mass number but different atomic numbers. They are…
questions.explanation: Different elements with the same mass number are isobars.

questions.q: Which is used to treat cancer?
questions.explanation: An isotope of cobalt treats cancer; an isotope of uranium fuels reactors; an isotope of iodine treats goitre.
